text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Was it just my imagination? I 
thought someone called out to me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, the Three Goddesses, huh. I think 
I read about them in a picture book when I 
was little.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna run cool and beautiful like that 
too!" ...is something you might tell your 
big brother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna run cool and beautiful like that 
too!" ...is something you might tell your 
big sister.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little bit, like back then—
